abstract_cost.candidate_heldout_motif_scans: every encoded motif is charged once when its graph is heldout
abstract_cost.candidate_model_definition: for every fold topology prediction record, charge topology node count plus internal edges plus external input uses plus outputs plus predicted body nodes plus predicted body inputs
abstract_cost.candidate_native_compile_units: twice the node count of each unique body for candidate and stock compilation
abstract_cost.candidate_training_motif_scans: every encoded motif is charged once in each of the four folds where its graph is training
abstract_cost.fixed_definition: one per target in every supplied fixed tool
abstract_cost.fixed_match_visits: one per attempted path node visit under the unchanged matcher
abstract_cost.total: sum of the named integer components within each route

decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: implementations, cost arithmetic, coverage, causality, hostile, or resource accounting disagree
decision_rule.local_utility_positive: candidate total abstract cost is lower than fixed total abstract cost or candidate-only nodes is nonzero, with two implementations and all hostile/resource gates passing
decision_rule.local_utility_valid_negative: complete execution passes but candidate is neither cheaper nor locally newly reachable

evaluation_universe.candidate_matches: the exact seventeen Phase164 rows executed by Phase165
evaluation_universe.candidate_tools: the three unique complete bodies executed by Phase165

reachability.candidate_coverage: unique nodes in the seventeen exact executed rows
reachability.candidate_only_families: families containing at least one candidate-only node
reachability.causal: removing all three candidate bodies removes every candidate node and candidate-only node
reachability.fixed_coverage: unique nodes in every unchanged fixed-portfolio match across the same twenty-three graphs
